name: PLANKA
description: Kanban boards for teams, with real-time updates, like Trello

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database with every board, card and user, and secrets.env with this install's own SECRET_KEY and database password. Back it up.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Attachments, avatars and board backgrounds. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: PLANKA web UI and API, published on host as 6762

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: BASE_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6762. PLANKA only works at this exact address. For a domain use https://boards.example.com; for both, put them side by side with a comma.

variables.name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The admin's email. PLANKA keeps this account as the main admin and you can't edit it in the app while this is set.

variables.name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The admin's password. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Set it here to change it; PLANKA applies it on every start.
